description: This Java source file defines the 'FeatureModified' event class, which is emitted after a Feature in the Eclipse Ditto framework has been modified. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the feature data.

classes.name: FeatureModified
classes.description: Represents an event emitted after a Feature has been modified in the system. Contains methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and access to feature data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of FeatureModified with various parameters, including deprecated string-based constructors and newer typed versions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event data.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the feature as a JSON value, schema-version dependent.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the feature resource.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends the feature payload to a JSON object builder for serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
